name: aws-lambda
description: Deploy to AWS Lambda with SAM, with a deploy proxy in your account for credentials without keys; read CloudFormation stacks and functions
author: actionplatform
needs: tool: aws, sam (bundled as Python packages when not on PATH)
env: AWS_REGION; credentials from proxy_url (the deploy proxy in your account, no keys), role_arn (OIDC, no keys) or the AWS CLI chain (SSO, profile, instance role)
net: *.amazonaws.com, the proxy url when set
